title: Model provider
description: One model provider route: the agent it serves, the credential it reads, the environment and arguments of the route, and the models the route uses as named slots. A value may hold {model:<slot>} for the id of a slot and {model:<slot>:effort} for the id with its effort in parentheses. A provider file is one route that names itself; the providers section of agentic.json holds routes by name.

route.description: The members of a provider route. A provider file and a route of the providers section share them.

name.description: The name a launch selects. A provider file is named <name>.json.

extends.description: A provider of the same agent to refine. Models and environment merge entry by entry, and args replace the inherited ones when set.

portable.description: True when the route is safe outside the local host environment.

sourceEnv.description: The host variable that holds the credential.

targetEnv.description: The variable the agent reads the credential from.
